# Projects and attachments

<!-- codeforge:local-only:start -->

Section 4 · Functional specifications

Parent page: [Functional specifications](section-4.md)

<!-- codeforge:local-only:end -->

<!-- codeforge:body:start (testo scrivibile: e' la sorgente pubblicata su Confluence) seed:f260c1bcfa3844f1 -->
Administrators create projects, initiatives and events, plan them with checklists and attach files; volunteers can take items. Status changes (standby, archive, close) restrict later edits. Attachments follow the same rules everywhere: staff only, description and retention mandatory, owner or administrator can edit or delete. Public progress sharing exposes only the checklist, not the project.
<!-- codeforge:body:end -->
